methodology.strategy_type: Inferred from scraped pastAdvices legs (BUY CE/PE only).
methodology.moneyness: Strike vs Nifty OPEN on trade date (±0.5% ATM, 0.5–1.5% near-OTM, >1.5% far-OTM).
methodology.regime: Bull/bear/sideways from Nifty daily close-to-close return (±0.4% thresholds).
methodology.trend: Compares CE/PE PnL on up-days vs down-days; cross-checked with exit family.
methodology.not_stratzy_copy: Bullets are research-generated; Stratzy marketing "about" text is not used.

algos.name: Index Scalper
bullets: Long single-leg option buyer — buys one CE or PE, profits when premium rises (not a credit spread).
Strike selection (2026 YTD): 39.7% in-the-money (higher delta, more intrinsic value), 38.6% deep out-of-the-money (>1.5%), 17.9% at-the-money (±0.5% of Nifty open).
Trade frequency: ~21.9 trades/month (Stratzy lists: "1 trade/day").
Exit mechanic: signal-based discretionary exit.
Trend-following — CE trades do better on up-days, PE on down-days.
Direction mix: 48.5% calls / 51.5% puts (balanced CE/PE).
Best on bull days (+9.0 pts avg, 2026 YTD): bull +9.0, sideways +6.4, bear +0.5
Wins on up-days despite mixed CE/PE — signal catches intraday momentum.

pairwise_highlights.headline: Momentum burst vs volatility vacuum — same GRID exit, different entry
bullets: Burst enters on momentum expansion; Vacuum fades vol-collapse snaps.
Burst ~3× more trades — higher turnover, more grid levels per month.

pairwise_highlights.headline: Same skew entry — only exit mechanics change
bullets: Identical skew-hunt signal; TSL adds systematic trailing stop.
Compare regime stats: TSL often more active in 2026.

pairwise_highlights.headline: Both fixed SL — width is the main difference
bullets: Savdhaan uses wider 35% hard stop; Sookshma caps at 25%.
Tighter stop = smaller losses but fewer large winners.

pairwise_highlights.headline: Same partial-book exit — different entry / PE tilt
bullets: Both book partial profits then trail the rest.
Check CE/PE mix and bear-day performance to pick between them.

pairwise_highlights.headline: Both TSL — vol-timing vs trail tightness
bullets: Settle-Down waits for vol to calm; Wise-Move uses tighter 25% trail.
Tighter TSL cuts winners earlier but limits give-back.
